_comment: Recorded native-versus-WASM browser divergences for the WASM parity gate. Each entry must state the fixture, the mechanism, the measured magnitude, and a tight bound so differences cannot silently grow.

components_i_cabinzone_dynamic.reason: ode23s transient with MoistAirSource/CabinZone evaluating HAPropsSI in the loop. rustprop uses std::f64::exp/ln/powf which resolves to glibc natively and compiler-rt/libm on wasm32; 1-ulp property variations integrate to a 6.66e-9 trajectory difference against the JDK/native baseline.

ev-battery-cooling-pid.reason: ode23s transient (4000 s, 400 rows) of a five-domain closed loop: BatteryPack -> LiquidWallHX cold plate -> Chiller (MovingBoundaryEvaporator, R134a) -> EXVCmd under a clamped PID. Its golden was regenerated natively on 2026-10-21 (LiquidWallHX exact isothermal-wall law), so native replay is exact; wasm32 resolves rustprop's exp/ln/powf through compiler-rt/libm instead of glibc, and the 1-ulp property differences integrate through the PID loop. The worst cell is ch.ev$l_tp at row 45 (diff 4.20e-6 m on a column scale of 0.948, 4.43e-6), where the evaporator's smooth-min zone-length corner amplifies them; the solved scalars agree to 1.8e-11. Before the regeneration this fixture carried a 3.6e-6 rustprop-vs-Java relaxation that absorbed the same effect.
